paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Sotah: “When Rabbi Yose the Pious and Rabbi Yose Ketanuta died, men of piety ceased.” See the entry Rabbi Yose the Priest.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice names both Yose the Pious and Yose Ketanuta; the cross-reference to Yose the Priest does not merge them.

The full closing halakhah paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9 has Rabbi Yose Chasida and Rabbi Yose Katonta and says men of piety ceased. The adjacent Mishnah paragraph has Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa and Yose Kitonta. These are source-specific lists; the supplied Yose the Priest cross-reference does not join identities.
